profile.name: Cornerstone 7400 单色仪
profile.description: 一款可电动调节输出波长并带有快门的光学单色仪，用于从宽带光源中选择窄带光，并在光谱测量、显微成像和材料光学表征实验中进行波长扫描与光路控制。
profile.description_en: A motorized optical monochromator with a shutter, used to select narrowband light from a broadband source and to perform wavelength scanning and light-path control in spectroscopy, microscopy, and optical characterization experiments.

rows.profile_value: 一款可电动调节输出波长并带有快门的光学单色仪，用于从宽带光源中选择窄带光，并在光谱测量、显微成像和材料光学表征实验中进行波长扫描与光路控制。

A motorized optical monochromator with a shutter, used to select narrowband light from a broadband source and to perform wavelength scanning and light-path control in spectroscopy, microscopy, and optical characterization experiments.
